title: Status
responsibility: Renders verification verdicts, compact icons, translated badges and cancellable run status with one shared implementation.

inputs.name: Status.passed
inputs.description: Optional verdict flag, default false. Only literal true is proven; used by verdict mode.

inputs.name: Status.variant
inputs.description: Optional mode, default verdict: verdict tooltip, Desktop icon, translated badge, or run progress.

inputs.name: Status.status
inputs.description: Optional status string, default unknown. Icon passes only for verified; badge translates the declared report status.

inputs.name: Status.reason
inputs.description: Optional icon explanation, default empty; empty displays No verification recorded for this revision.

inputs.name: Status.active
inputs.description: Optional run activity flag, default false. True shows Cancel run.

inputs.name: Status.cancel
inputs.description: Optional callback. Defaults to JavaScript undefined. Called only when Cancel run is clicked; errors propagate.

inputs.name: Status.children
inputs.description: Optional run content snippet. Defaults to JavaScript undefined. Omitted content displays label; rendering errors propagate.

inputs.name: Status.label
inputs.description: Optional words. Defaults to JavaScript undefined. Verdict defaults to Full coverage passed or Verification failed; run omits empty labels.

inputs.name: Status.reasons
inputs.description: Optional ordered failure reasons, default []; a successful verdict omits them.

inputs.name: Status.framed
inputs.description: Optional verdict outline, default false; true preserves the framed icon treatment.

inputs.name: Status.bare
inputs.description: Optional compatibility input. Defaults to JavaScript undefined; verdict mode always draws only the icon.

outputs.name: Status
outputs.description: The requested status treatment: verdict with accessible tooltip, Desktop check or cross, translated badge, or run text with an optional cancellation action. Each mode retains its own existing visual behavior. States: passed-open: The passing verdict tooltip is open with its successful verification label. failed-open: The failing verdict tooltip is open with its recorded reasons. unknown-open: The unknown verdict tooltip is open with its missing-evidence reasons. long-open: The failing tooltip contains many long reasons and scrolls within the viewport. icon-failed: Icon mode shows a cross with the failed-verification explanation. icon-unverified: Icon mode shows a cross with the unverified-revision explanation. icon-unknown: Icon mode shows a cross with the unknown-status explanation. icon-no-reason: Icon mode falls back to No verification recorded for this revision. icon-open: Icon mode exposes its reason status when focused, hovered or activated. icon-long: Icon mode displays a long verification-gap explanation. badge-passed: Badge mode displays the translated passed label and decorative dot. badge-running: Badge mode displays the translated running label and decorative dot. badge-failed: Badge mode displays the translated failed label and decorative dot. badge-blocked: Badge mode displays the translated blocked label and decorative dot. badge-skipped: Badge mode displays the translated skipped label and decorative dot. badge-not-proven: Badge mode displays the translated not-proven label and decorative dot. badge-interrupted: Badge mode displays the translated interrupted label and decorative dot. run-idle: Run mode retains its status content without an active Cancel run action. verdict: The verdict marker shows the supplied verification label and expandable reasons. badge: The translated status label and decorative dot appear without a verdict tooltip.

errors.name: Caller rendering or callback error
errors.description: Errors from run content or cancellation callbacks propagate. Tooltip placement reads only the visible verdict elements.
